audit.whatIsWrong: Primal Howl is absent from the entire page, and no Warwick ability was ever named in the full layer.
audit.why: Riot text: 'Warwick gains damage reduction for 2.5 seconds. At the end, or if re-activated, he howls, causing nearby enemies to flee for 1 second.' 375 range, 15/14/13/12/11s. A 1s flee is a hard stop on a champion whose whole kit assumes movement, and the 2.5s damage reduction blunts the W sweetspot burst — this is the interaction that decides trades, and it was missing. Also unstated: Blood Hunt is 4000 range on 80/70/60/50/40s and triggers at 50% HP, tripling at 25%; Infinite Duress is 110/90/70s and suppresses the first champion collided with for 1.5s; Jaws of the Beast is a 365-range dash on 8/7.5/7/6.5/6 dealing max-health damage and healing him.
audit.corrected: Primal Howl's damage reduction and 1s fear now stated with range, plus real cooldowns for R and Q, and the Blood Hunt HP thresholds.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Its cooldown is the green light' with no number.

edits.before: Q's outer ring on his last-hits plus the passive speed means he literally cannot touch you at level 1.
edits.after: One ability each and no kite chain yet — Warwick is a weak duelist before his W, so level 1 is a wash.

edits.before: - Warwick Infinite Duress: matchup-defining — Lock-on suppress — track it before every step-up. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget passive move speed for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Infinite Duress: 110/90/70s, a 1.5s suppress on the first champion he hits. - Primal Howl gives him 2.5s damage reduction, then a 1s fear at 375 range. - Jaws of the Beast is a 6-8s dash that heals him for what it bites off you.

edits.after: Infinite Duress: 110/90/70s, 1.5s suppress on the first champion hit. Primal Howl gives him 2.5s damage reduction, then a 1s fear.

edits.before: Lock-on suppress — track it before every step-up. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.

edits.before: Warwick spends Infinite Duress early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.

notes: spikes[2].text claims Infinite Duress is 'a point-blank suppress lock you cannot cleanse'. Riot's text says only that it suppresses for 1.5 seconds; suppression's interaction with Cleanse and QSS is not in the kit data, so I left that sentence untouched rather than restate or contradict it. Listing it as unverified. Also unverified: whether Lillia's R Drowsy can interrupt Infinite Duress mid-channel — the kit marks his R 'channel: interruptible' but does not say which CC types break it.
